description: NaSbO₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnna space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-62°. There are two shorter (2.16 Å) and four longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Sb₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
